programme.desc:

programme.desc: The award-winning true-life story of the dual-engine Norton motorcycle dragster designed, built, and raced by TC Christenson and John Gregory of Sunset Motors. The documentary chronicles the Sunset Motors Racing Team’s unrivaled innovation and unbridled courage as they faced unyielding challengers throughout the United States and Europe in the 1970’s. TC and John are featured as they relate their experiences of those years rising from local street racers to the top race team in the world. programme.desc: In Django Defies Sartana, two of the West’s deadliest gunslingers clash in a storm of bullets and betrayal. programme.title: Romance on the Range 1942
programme.desc: Roy Rogers brings song and spirit to Romance on the Range! When cattle rustlers stir up trouble on the frontier, Roy saddles up to protect the ranchers and bring the outlaws to justice. Along the way, his courage and charm win more than just gunfights, as romance blossoms under the wide-open skies. With the Sons of the Pioneers providing harmony and plenty of action on the trail, this Western blends music, adventure, and heart in true Roy Rogers style.

programme.title: Django, Kill! 1967
programme.desc: In "Django, Kill!" Tomas Milian stars in one of the most surreal and violent Spaghetti Westerns ever filmed. Left for dead after a gold robbery, a mysterious gunslinger claws his way back to life and hunts down the traitors who betrayed him. Along the way, he enters a nightmare world of greed, cruelty, and madness where no one can be trusted. Brutal, hallucinatory, and unforgettable, this cult classic pushes the Western to its wildest limits.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our Overlanding Toyota 4Runner gets a new exhaust and a few creature comforts to help us while exploring the wild. Then the guys head out to Mother Nature's playground to see how it all performs.
programme.sub-title: Will The Overlanding Toyota 4Runner Upgrades Hold Up On The Trail? - Part 4

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We complete our stroker LS powerplant and put it to the ultimate performance test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We start with a Gen IV Iron Block 5.3L from the junkyard, get it running, and then add a selection of budget-friendly upgrades to turn it into a solid street swap engine. Afterward, we test our upgrades on the dyno and get a special visit from a high horsepower, big boost drag car.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Diesel truck drag racer Lavon Miller has been pushing the boundaries at the strip. He's in our shop with all the race winning insight used for his record-breaking season. Plus, solving a thrown code on a 2006 Dodge Ram 1500.
programme.sub-title: Winning at the Track with the 3000HP Diesel Master

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: A 2017 Camaro SS is upgraded to be given away to one lucky viewer.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine a Bug and a UTV? The answer: BajAwesome. The Carcass team builds a baja style bug with a left for dead VW Beetle and a stock Can-Am Maverick X3. This is part 1 of a 3 part BajAwesome build.
programme.sub-title: Building a Baja Style Bug With a VW Beetle and A Stock Can-Am Maverick X3

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Willys Mud Wagon gets some finishing touches before it takes to the mud pits. With Big tires, a 630 horse power engine, and over 3 feet of ground clearance to the body, will it survive?
programme.sub-title: Burying Our Wills Wagon in The Mud

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We upgrade the brakes, repair underside problems, and put some great new off-road and recovery mods on our 2007 Jeep Wrangler JK. Then we'll take it out for a wheeling adventure.
programme.sub-title: Modding A Jeep Wrangler JK Into An Extreme Off-Road Weekend Warrior Part 2

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We picked up a 1985 Chevy K-10 with a plan to do a full rebuild. But with just a few small repairs and upgrades that you can do in your driveway, we can get this Chevy back on its feet. Next stop? We're going offroad for a little trail action!
programme.sub-title: Getting The K10 Square Body Up and Running

programme.title: MuscleCar
programme.desc: Work continues on the MuscleCar COPO Camaro tribute project as the guys get to work building a suspension system that looks and works like an original high performance 1969 Camaro's would have. Tommy teaches you how to chop down a barn find Impala 12-bolt rear end to fit under a Camaro and Mank works on revitalizing the stock front end components.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!
programme.sub-title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Project Cream Puff takes a huge step forward in this episode as the MCT crew installs an air-ride suspension system, giving the build its signature low, effortless stance while cruising the streets. Plus, we'll unleash some serious power with the addition of a supercharged boost, transforming our C-10 into a street machine with both style and muscle.
programme.sub-title: Chevy C-10 - Part 9: Low Ride, High Power

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's fabrication time on our Chevy Suburban we're calling "Unbreakable", and with the help of Jeremy and Jimmy from Carcass the guys build an off-road-ready frame that's out of this world.
programme.sub-title: Tearing Down and Rebuilding a Kingpin Dana 60 Axle

programme.title: PowerNation on the Road
programme.desc: The XOR team and a group of off-road enthusiasts hit the trails on the XOR Adventure Ride 4. This year the team heads to the heart of coal country in West Virginia! Everything from the XOR JL Rubicon to the General Tire Tacoma to ATVs hit the trails.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Rebuild or buy? This is Austin's diesel dilemma after his daily driver breaks down in the driveway. Plus Dragonali, our '11 Denali HD gets traction bars and fender clearance for bigger wheels & tires.
programme.sub-title: Rebuild or Buy: Pros and Cons of a Powerstroke Failure

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We're starting with a high-mileage 5.3L Vortec that we got on the cheap. Our goal: make as much horsepower as we can, spending the least money possible.
programme.sub-title: Minor Upgrades Create Crazy Power on a Junkyard 5.3L Vortec

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's final assembly for our 1974 Bronco. We'll install a Coyote engine, rollbar, and bedliner, plus a super smooth cut and buff on the new paint job.
programme.sub-title: Adding Coyote Power to a Rebuilt Bronco

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We show you all the trucks, from late models to classics, including BIGFOOT, and a drifting exhibition, that are on display to the public at the first annual Power Nationals event in Nashville.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: A burned-up 6.4L Gen III HEMI is revived with some old school hot rod parts.
programme.sub-title: Burnt Junkyard 6.4L Gen III HEMI Rises From The Ashes

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our 1972 C-10 is in the shop for a comfort upgrade. We're installing a modern HVAC system, adding heat and sound dampening, and sharing a few wiring tips to keep Cream Puff running cool and smooth.
programme.sub-title: Chevy C-10 - Part 10: Cool and Comfortable

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We add a new rear axle to our '76 Caddy Hearse drag car, helping all the horsepower to grip the pavement. Plus, we add brake upgrades to help bring it to a dead stop.
programme.sub-title: Upgrading the Drag Strip Caddy Hearse Rear Axle and Suspension

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Learn how to do a rustic looking patina paint job on your ride, and see a quick way to ratchet up the performance numbers on a late model pony.
programme.sub-title: Sydewinder Patina Paint and Late Model Tuning

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy puts the finishing touches on Project Hard Charger's hood and we start tackling the interior getting ready for the final push.
programme.sub-title: Project Hard Charger Gets a New Interior

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The guys make room on Junk Mail for bigger wheels and tires with a few body modifications. We make some custom bumpers and add a roll cage. Then we get the body of the frame for final welding and paint
programme.sub-title: Junkmail Jeep's Big Tires Means More Body Clearance

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our rolling dyno sled receives a fuel system, intercooler, and hand-built exhaust. Plus: take a visit inside Dustless Blasting's manufacturing facility.
programme.sub-title: Custom Cooling, Custom Exhaust, The Test Sled Build is On!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We make repairs on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, showing you how to remove rust and pull dents. Then, we'll cruise around in a '73 Camaro to diagnose what needs fixing as we help another viewer with a Driveway Rescue.
programme.sub-title: Busting Rust & Mending Dents On The '71 Caprice - Fat Stack Part 4

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We start the final push getting Junk Mail one step closer to the trail. We tackle our wiring, plumb up our cooling and fuel systems. Then, we fabricate our exhaust before firing the '78 Postal Jeep up for the first time.
programme.sub-title: Firing Up The JunkMail Jeep For The First Time

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We put our past engine builds to the test now that they have been installed in awesome hot rods! From the Gen III Hemi of Detroit Muscle's "Road Burner" to the 496ci Big Block Chevy of Music City Trucks' "Faux Guy", we put the power down to the wheels and get final wheel horsepower numbers.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Now that our Ram 1500 is looking better, we take it up a notch with a 4-inch lift, new wheels and tires, and an exhaust system to make it sound as good as it looks.
programme.sub-title: Suspension Upgrade Gives The Ram 1500 A 4" Lift

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: We buy a '02 Sierra on the cheap and turn it into a reliable, powerful daily driver. First a leveling kit, wheels, and tires for a brand new stance.
programme.sub-title: Adding '90s Flair To A 2000s GMC Daily Driver

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.desc: The new "evolved" Charlie has to deal with a ghost from his old carousing, baseball-playing days when a unattractive woman he slept with just to break a batting slump shows up as a new patient in group therapy.

programme.sub-title: Charlie's Patient Gets Out of Jail

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.
programme.sub-title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to some of the richest marine ecosystems in the world; biologists and conservationists have undertaken a race against time to better understand and protect marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: July (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret.

He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, a man finds himself in jail over stolen blueberries; a woman who has spent her life running from the law decides to surrender; in Modesto, a professional motorcycle racer hopes to bail out in time to make the nationals.

programme.title: Booked: First Day In
programme.desc: Speed Racers and a Diplomat charge their way into jail while a jealous boyfriend fights his way in; a hungry homeless man makes a regrettable decision; a pregnant mom is hoping she doesn't give birth while in handcuffs.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: My One Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

programme.title: Christmas in Carolina
programme.desc: Career-driven investment banker Elle has given up on love until she meets Wesley, who invites her to his hometown in South Carolina, where she rediscovers the spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Caught in the Crossfire
programme.desc: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: If Beale Street Could Talk
programme.desc: In early 1970s Harlem, daughter and wife-to-be Tish vividly recalls the passion, respect and trust that have connected her and her artist fiancé Alonzo Hunt, who goes by the nickname Fonny. Friends since childhood, the devoted couple dream of a future together, but their plans are derailed when Fonny is arrested for a crime he did not commit.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Cut Throat City
programme.desc: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

programme.title: Snipes
programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Cops and Robbers
programme.desc: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process.

programme.title: History by the Numbers
programme.desc: Whether it's for a chance to cut loose, to break the rules, or to just plain show off, there's no knowing which party will go down in history; thirteen of them stand out for excess, success, or epic failure.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944... Operation Overlord was a colossal undertaking. 150,000 Allied Forces landed on five beaches in Normandy, France. It was the first phase in the liberation of Western Europe. When GIs from the First U.S. Army landed, the Allies believed the Germans would withdraw to the Seine. The American Forces would then advance to Brittany, the banks of the Loire, and Paris, but they were wrong!

programme.title: Guy Martin: D-Day Landing
programme.desc: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane, undergoes brutal training with the Red Devils parachute display team, and parachutes into the Normandy countryside.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Total war extends the battlefields - in the Second World War, for the first time, civilian casualties far outnumbered those of military personnel. And a significant proportion of those casualties were victims of the bombing campaigns waged by both sides. What was the effect of living through 'the Blitz', what precautions were taken, what forms of shelter were constructed?

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: In the early morning hours of the 17th of January 1991, coalition air forces unleashed a massive air assault on Iraqi forces in both Iraq and Kuwait. The magnitude of the coalition air offensive dealt a crushing blow to Iraq's air defense network.

programme.title: Einsatzgruppen: The Nazi Death Squads
programme.desc: Carnage continues from September to December 1941. After the EZG's intervention, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary and the Baltic states are declared 'Judenfrei': free of Jews.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As 1942 drew to a close, the Allies were really beginning to make headway. The British made a crucial breakthrough in North Africa, and the Americans pushed the Japanese out of Burma and New Guinea. In Russia the Germans found themselves surrounded.
programme.sub-title: The Tide Begins to Turn: October-December 1942

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The only option for the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad was surrender, while all across Russia the Red Army consolidated their advantage. Also, as German cities encountered the kind of bombing that Britain faced back in 1940, courtesy of the RAF.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, the Nazi Party created the Hitler Youth to indoctrinate children and adolescents with Nazi ideology and prepare them to become a child army for Hitler. This episode traces the rise of the movement, from early everyday life indoctrination, through to the war.
programme.sub-title: The Hitler Youth: Nazi Child Army

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East Collection
programme.desc: Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf. The Allied Coalition's air war, known as Operation Desert Storm, involved the most sophisticated technological weaponry available.
programme.sub-title: Modern Warfare: The Persian Gulf War - Part 2

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: In the Warsaw ghetto, Emanuel Ringelblum and the other members of the documentary group Oyneg Shabbos collected whatever they could to recount life in the ghetto. When they learn of the death at Chelmno of Jews from neighboring towns and from the Lodz ghetto at the end of 1941, they realized that the Nazis and their local auxiliaries had embarked on an operation of annihilation.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.
programme.sub-title: Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the Allied campaign in the Gilbert Islands in the central Pacific. Allied aircraft first target the Marshall and Gilbert islands in a series of raids. The United States, then, uses amphibious landings to attack the atolls of Makin and Tarawa. Casualties are heavy on Tarawa, but eventually the atoll is taken.
programme.sub-title: Attack in the Central Pacific: Makin and Tarawa

programme.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
programme.desc: Once again, the USAAF 1st Motion Picture Unit witnesses, first hand, a deadly mission against the tyranny of Nazi Germany. B17 and B24 Bombers of the Mighty Eighth are assaulted by deadly anti-aircraft guns and savaged by Herman Goring's Luftwaffe. Fighting their way to the target, mile by mile, to drop their bombs, the surviving crews can only then dare to hope they might make it home again...

programme.title: Jets
programme.desc: The air war in Vietnam was unlike any other. It was the full might of the world's greatest military power pitted against an elusive, but highly motivated enemy. From an air combat perspective, the Vietnam War provided the superpowers, the US and the USSR, with the opportunity to put their best technology, and weapons systems, into the sky to fight it out.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The draft law of 1940 is passed and American men are inducted into the Army. Large-scale maneuvers are held in 1941. Pearl Harbor is bombed and Franklin Roosevelt asks Congress for a declaration of war.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: Americans arrive in Britain, try to get along with the British civilians, and are made ready physically and mentally to fight the Germans. The Eighth Air Force begins its bombing offensive, and the decision is made to invade French North Africa.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: In 1941, as Nazi Germany invaded, the USSR faced collapse. Stalin ordered entire factories moved east by train-steelworks, tank plants, munitions lines. Millions of workers became an army of labor, rebuilding industry and forging weapons far from the front.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Ewald von Kleist has broken through to the Terek river, slap in front of the vital oil fields of Grozny and Baku. Only freezing temperatures in the Caucasus prevent von Kleist's 1st Panzer Army from breaking through to Ozoni Kizi and Tbilisi. The Soviets launch a desperate counter-attack that holds the Germans back.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches: 1944-1945
programme.desc: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder. In the final months of World War II, 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe. 250,000 to 300,000 died from exhaustion or were massacred by the guards or even civilians in Austria and Germany.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: June 1914, Europe was in the midst of an idealic summer. The nations of Europe were joined together by webs of trade and capital. Their royal houses linked by bonds of family and marriage. Global trade was at an all time high. The prospect of all an all out European war was unthinkable, pundits said. No one saw the catastrophe coming, until it came. World War I - The War to End All Wars.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the swift success at Smolensk, Hitler has diverted the bulk of Heinz Guderian's panzers down to the South, so as to capture the Ukrainian capital Kiev, considered more important than Moscow in Hitler's mind. It begins a gigantic clash and turns out to be the biggest military encirclement in history.

programme.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Hitler was losing the war in 1944. In the East, Russians rolled forward relentlessly, threatening the existence of Hitler's Third Reich. Hitler knew that if he were to survive, he needed a miracle. New technologies, or miracle weapons, could turn the tide of war. Against all odds, German engineers not only designed but produced in good numbers some of the best aircraft of the war, the ME262.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Sergeant Cleo Lehenbauer, nicknamed 'Indestructible,' is wounded during the 101st Airborne's D-Day jump and after being hospitalized returns to Normandy. In September, he walks through a mine infested field and rescues two comrades in Holland. After conflicts with his commander in the 5th Armored Division, he transfers back to the 101st, where he helps stop the last major German offensive.

programme.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
programme.desc: This program presents the history of marine amphibious operations from the earliest days of the republic in 1776 at New Providence Island when the continental marines were led in an early amphibious operation against the British, to the marine corps amphibious operations during the Korean War in the 1950's.
